instruction: A professional corporate photograph with a full-length, eye-level shot captures a modern, minimalist office with a desk, chair, and grey paneled wall. On the left, the woman in the dark skirt suit (R2) stands in profile facing right, smiling as she extends her right hand. On the right, the man in the dark suit (R1) stands in profile facing left, smiling slightly with his left hand in his pocket while extending his right hand. The woman (R2) and the man (R1) shake hands firmly in the center of the frame. The scene is illuminated by bright, even office lighting, creating a clean, neutral color palette with cool grey tones.
